title: vaporize test mode resolved bare swift through Swiftly 6.3.2 instead of Xcode-selected Swift 6.4
createdBy: chatgpt loom harness after operator correction to test via vaporize

historicalContent.triggeredBy: While correcting savepoint verification to run through Vaporize, `vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path .../savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia test -- --disable-automatic-resolution` failed before tests because Vaporize executed `/Users/sonoma/.swiftly/bin/swift test`, whose installed Swift version was 6.3.2, against a Swift tools 6.4 package.
historicalContent.observedFailure:
$ /Users/sonoma/.swiftly/bin/swift test --package-path private/universal/domain/scm/digikoma/savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia -c release --disable-automatic-resolution
error: package 'savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia' is using Swift tools version 6.4.0 but the installed version is 6.3.2
historicalContent.expectedBehavior: Vaporize's SwiftPM build/test/package lanes should use the Xcode-selected Swift toolchain so substrate Swift 6.4 packages test through the canonical Vaporize gate.
historicalContent.fixSummary: Vaporize now routes `runSwift` and `runSwiftPackage` through `xcrun swift ...`; a CUJ-01 regression verifies that SwiftPM package commands are prefixed as Xcode-selected Swift arguments.
verification: Installed patched Vaporize binary at `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh`; previous binary backed up to `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh.bak-20260626T105502Z`.

Focused Vaporize regression passed through Vaporize: `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --configuration debug test -- --disable-automatic-resolution --filter 'CUJ-01 routes SwiftPM package commands through Xcode-selected Swift'`.

Savepoint package canonical proof passed through Vaporize: `/Users/sonoma/.swiftpm/bin/vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh --package-path private/universal/domain/scm/digikoma/savepoint-commit.digikoma.clia test -- --disable-automatic-resolution`; Vaporize printed `$ /usr/bin/xcrun swift test ...` and the suite passed 15 tests in 2 suites.

savepointRefs.t: wrkstrm-core savepoint fixing Vaporize SwiftPM package test/build toolchain selection
